## Appearance

Marshall is an eccentric individual with a distinct physical appearance. He has long hair and a long beard, which sets him apart from those around him.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006)_

## Personality

Marshall is a witty, intelligent, and well-read man who possesses a bit of a temper and a reputation for being both stubborn and very determined. Known for his ability to rival Captain Jim in telling a good story, he sang old Scotch ballads in a fine tenor voice and had been a noted dancer in his youth.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

## History

In his youth, Marshall Elliott was known as a noted dancer, but he later made a public vow to refrain from shaving his face or cutting his hair until the [Grits](../codex/factions.md#grit) political party came to power. Living near [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), he occasionally gathered at the lighthouse with local residents, joining [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and Captain Jim to celebrate New Year's Eve with music and dancing around the fire. Following a [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory in a federal election, Marshall finally shaved off his long-held beard, causing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to temporarily fail to recognize him when they met shortly before Captain Jim's death.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--marshall.md)

Marshall Elliott and Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) become betrothed in Volume 4, with news of their upcoming marriage surprising their mutual acquaintances. The engagement marks a major shift in Marshall's personal life, leading him to shave off his long-held beard prior to the announcement. Their union unites two prominent community figures who share an interest in local politics and church affairs.

- Romantically involved with — betrothed / going to be married (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037)</sub>
- Spouse of — engagement/upcoming marriage (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037)</sub>
